decisions.reason: Selecting a 2.5-quart bowl does not change the existing requirements for cleaning the bowls, spout, or whisk.
The selected capacity does not alter the existing quick-removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
The source Event establishes bowl capacity only and does not establish or change any food-contact material.
The candidate already specifies a 2.5-quart target bowl capacity, so the source decision causes no state change.
Selecting a 2.5-quart bowl remains compatible with the existing compact-enclosure and deep-well constraints without changing them.
The bowl selection supports the existing mixing-quality objective but does not modify its required result or behavior.
Bowl capacity does not change the electrical architecture or load-capacity requirements; the candidate's same-message Event concerns separate BOM power components.
The selected bowl capacity does not change the existing event-use reliability or electrical-load requirements.
The capacity selection does not alter the existing splash-control target or approved mitigation methods.
Selecting the bowl capacity does not change the solenoid mechanism, button actuation, or closed-state behavior.
The capacity selection does not modify the required dispensing flow profile, sequence, or froth-preservation behavior.
BOM approval of the selected bowl capacity does not change the placard text, placement, or intended viewer.
